messages:
emily_marketing: Quick sync — post-benchmark email + webinar follow-up drip. Need segmentation, send windows, and 1P suppression rules. TL;DR: three cohorts: 1) engaged webinar attendees, 2) registrants who didn’t attend, 3) benchmark-downloaders who haven’t converted. Can we finalize cadence and subject line variants?
maya_growth: I can own cohort splits and suppression. propose: attendees = Day0 recap, Day4 tips, Day10 CTA; registrants-no-show = Day1 recap + invite to on-demand; downloaders = staggered 3-touch spaced 5 days. thoughts? :sparkles:
sam_copy: Subject ideas: attendees: "Thanks — your benchmark recap + highlights"; no-shows: "Missed it? Watch on-demand + top takeaways"; downloaders: "How teams cut inference costs — your benchmark inside". Keep A/B on personalization vs benefit.
jules_ops: audience sizes? need counts before we spike sends and to set quotas for deliverability. also confirm opt-out cascade and suppression: marketing_global_unsub + paid_customers + recent_sent_7d.
emily_marketing: counts: attendees=4,200; registrants-no-show=1,150; downloaders-only=2,800. Spreadsheet with segments + sample rows: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1X-EXAMPLE. Suppression rules above — add recent_trialers_30d too.
maya_growth: added recent_trialers_30d. deliverability note: scale attendees over 3 waves to avoid throttles. propose windows: APAC 10:00-11:30 local, EMEA 10:00-12:00 local, NA 10:00-11:00 local.
emily_marketing: good. can you paste a quick send schedule (UTC) for eng ops to ingest?
maya_growth: sure — paste below:
```
Attendees (4,200) wave1 UTC: 2024-05-14T14:00Z (APAC-sliced)
Attendees wave2 UTC: 2024-05-14T20:00Z (EMEA-sliced)
Attendees wave3 UTC: 2024-05-15T15:00Z (NA-sliced)
Registrants-no-show: 2024-05-15T16:00Z
Downloaders drip: Day0=2024-05-16T12:00Z, Day5=2024-05-21T12:00Z, Day10=2024-05-26T12:00Z
```
sam_copy: also recommend subject send-time test for NA wave1 (10:00 vs 15:00 local). keep 10% A/B.
campaign-bot: Campaign stub created: campaign_id=emberwave-post-benchmark-1749994321. Drafts assigned to emily_marketing, sam_copy. Staging preview available: https://campaigns.redwood.example/emberwave/preview
emily_marketing: thanks bot. next steps: maya finalize send windows + suppression list by EOD, sam finalize subject variants + preheader, jules confirm quotas and ramp plan with eng-ops. I'll consolidate final brief and schedule a 15m sign-off at 18:00 UTC.
maya_growth: on it — will upload segment CSV to GCS and ping ops once uploaded.
jules_ops: will loop in eng-ops; ping me when CSV is ready.
sam_copy: will drop copy in the doc and flag preferred variants.
emily_marketing: perfect. any last blockers?
maya_growth: none from my side. :+1:
sam_copy: good to go from copy POV.
campaign-bot: Reminder scheduled: sign-off meeting at 2024-05-13T18:00Z.
emily_marketing: cool — see you all at sign-off. :rocket:
